node.statement: Polar-normal bound: the typed identity in the preceding step gives U^dagger-W=W bold-dot Q, hence ||W bold-dot Q||<=C_grp*epsilon_r. Since W is unitary, W^dagger bold-dot W=J. Approximate associativity and the product bound imply ||Q||<= (1+epsilon_r)||W|| C_grp*epsilon_r + epsilon_r||W||^2||Q||. The Cstar lower bound applied to W^dagger bold-dot W=J gives ||W||<=(1-epsilon_r)^(-1/2). After making the later C_der guard enforce a universal smallness cutoff on epsilon_r, the last term is absorbed and ||Q||<=K_q*C_grp*epsilon_r for a universal K_q.
